text: {"assertions":["On 2026-03-04, an empty result set bug in search/query/rewriter.ts was diagnosed and fixed.","The empty result set bug only manifested for traffic arriving through the corporate proxy.","The bug could be reproduced by searching for a two-word phrase containing a stop word.","The root cause was schema drift between the migration and the machine learning model.","The fix involved regenerating the model from the migration and pinning its checksum in PR #3134 on branch fix/empty-result-set-1.","The error rate decreased from 5.0% to under 0.04% (4 per 10,000) after the fix was applied.","This empty result set issue was located in the same area of search/query/rewriter.ts as earlier empty result set work."]}
